channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trey Murphy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trey Murphy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Adelman on Trey Murphy
item.description:
David Adelman on Trey Murphy III:

“One of the more underrated players in the West. He has given us buckets for years. I feel like his highlight dunks are against us. Now he gets a reverse 360 layup. ...I wish he would get traded to the East.”

David Adelman on Trey Murphy, Jan 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Willie Green on Trey Murphy
item.description:
Willie Green on Trey Murphy's season:

“Trey has taken a step up. He’s doing a lot more than in the past. He’s always been a good shooter. Now he’s handling the ball, playmaking, guarding some of the best players on the defensive side. We all love what we’re seeing from him.”

Willie Green on Trey Murphy, Mar 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Jose Alvarado on Trey Murphy
item.description:
Jose Alvarado on Trey Murphy's goals:

“I don’t know if he’s going to be mad about me saying this, but he told me on the bus he will be in (the All-Star Game) next year. This is his mindset. And I believe him. I just see his work, his mindset and how he attacks this game.”

Jose Alvarado on Trey Murphy, Jan 17, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Willie Green on Trey Murphy
item.description:
Willie Green on Trey Murphy (hamstring strain, will be re-examined in 3 weeks):

“Tough news. He looked really good coming into camp. He was playing well. I’m not quite sure exactly how it happened, but he’s disappointed. We’re a little disappointed. But it’s part of the game.”

Willie Green on Trey Murphy, Oct 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Willie Green on Trey Murphy
item.description:
Willie Green on progress of Trey Murphy (knee):

“So far, so good. He’s on track. He’s doing great. You guys have seen him on the floor shooting. That’s another step in his rehabilitation progress.”

Willie Green on Trey Murphy, Oct 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Trey Murphy
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Larry Nance Jr. on Trey Murphy (68% on 3s through 4 games):

“There's nothing Trey does that shocks me. His work ethic this summer, him and Herb were working like dogs. To see him step into this role and excel, I’m not shocked. This is Trey Murphy. You should get used to it.”

Larry Nance Jr on Trey Murphy, Oct 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Devonte Graham on Herb Jones, Trey Murphy
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:Devonte' Graham on tonight's @BallySportsNO interview about Trey Murphy III and Herb Jones:

“My two rook's, man, oh my God, man, they're gonna be good. I've been telling people that back home.”

Devonte Graham on Herb Jones, Trey Murphy, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.
